title: The Cross-Context Threshold Test: Detecting Discrimination Under Environmental Shifts
abstract: arXiv:2611.28259v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how threshold tests for detecting discrimination under environmental shifts, focusing on the Veil-of-Darkness (VoD) setting where visibility changes between daylight and darkness. We show that standard threshold tests, when applied separately to daylight and darkness data, violate key assumptions: risk distributions drift across contexts and thresholds fluctuate arbitrarily. We propose a cross-context threshold test that enforces distributional invariance and monotonic threshold decay. Using New York City stop-and-frisk data and synthetic experiments, we demonstrate that this model yields more reliable thresholds, improves bias detection, and aligns with the counterfactual logic of the VoD test. Our framework generalizes to fairness auditing whenever environmental context influences decisions.

translated_title: 跨情境阈值检验：在环境变化下检测歧视
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在环境变化下用于检测歧视的阈值检验方法，重点关注“黑暗面纱”设定的场景，即能见度在白天与黑夜之间发生变化。我们表明，标准阈值检验在分别应用于白天和黑夜数据时会违反关键假设：风险分布在情境之间发生漂移，且阈值会任意波动。我们提出了一种跨情境阈值检验方法，该方法强制执行分布不变性和单调阈值衰减。利用纽约市“拦截搜身”数据和合成实验，我们证明该模型能够产生更可靠的阈值、改进偏见检测效果，并与VoD检验的反事实逻辑相一致。只要环境情境会影响决策，我们的框架即可推广应用于公平性审计。
tldr: 本文提出了一种跨情境阈值检验方法，通过强制分布不变性和单调阈值衰减，克服了标准阈值检验在昼夜能见度等环境变化下假设失效的问题，从而在纽约市拦截搜身数据上实现了更可靠的歧视检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a cross-context threshold test that enforces distributional invariance and monotonic threshold decay, overcoming the failure of standard threshold tests under environmental shifts (e.g., daylight vs. darkness) and enabling more reliable discrimination detection.
